quotes.text: add a doc comment to test functions to document what case they test

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: If a Rust test's case is hard to infer from its name, add a short /// comment that states the case. A reader should not need to trace most of the helper implementation to know why the test exists.
title: Document non-obvious Rust test cases in a doc comment
